defects: The 'À RETENIR : l'Aâsser, la prière de l'après-midi' banner from the previous scene is still visible at the top of the souk establishing plate.
tiles.fix: Remove the leftover 'À RETENIR' banner overlay from this establishing shot.

defects: All four characters (Father, Boy, Mother, Fatma) are scaled far too small for the painted souk alley at their ground contact point, standing barely as tall as the adjacent shop counter on the left.

The characters are posed in a static, frozen cluster facing different directions (Father facing camera with arms stiff at his sides, Boy in profile facing Father's hip, Mother and Fatma standing side-by-side facing camera) instead of walking down the alley with the women following behind.
tiles.fix: Scale the four characters up by ~35% to match the shop counter perspective and pose them in a walking progression down the alley with Father and Boy leading and Mother and Fatma following a few steps behind.

defects: In this medium crop of s12 8.7, Father, Mother, and Fatma stand in stiff, mannequin-like frontal poses with arms hanging straight down while Boy stares into Father's hip, failing to read as walking through the souk.
Character scale against the immediate left shop counter makes Father look child-sized relative to the stall architecture.
tiles.fix: Use the rescaled walking staging from s12 8.7 and angle the characters in 3/4 view moving forward along the souk aisle.

defects: Boy's eye-line is barely at the height of the wooden counter rim so he cannot see down into the glass jewelry display case, and his arms hang stiffly at his sides.
tiles.fix: Position Boy slightly further back or raise him onto his tiptoes with hands resting on the counter edge so his gaze clears the wooden molding into the display case.

defects: Staging contradicts the line 'Dans les coins...': the weeping man and woman are placed dead center in the bright, open main thoroughfare rather than tucked into a recessed corner or side niche.

Both characters use stiff, mirrored hands-to-face poses with their fingers clipping into their cheeks and headscarves, and the woman wears an uncovered indoor red dress instead of outdoor street attire (haïk/djellaba).
tiles.fix: Move the pair to the shaded side wall/alcove by the shop pillars, dress the woman in an outdoor haïk or djellaba, and offset their grieving poses so their hands do not clip into their faces.

defects: Same central-street staging, hand-to-face mesh clipping, and indoor wardrobe defects as s12 27.0, plus the bottom of the frame cuts straight through both characters' ankles/feet.
tiles.fix: Reframe the crop either above the knees (medium shot) or wide enough to include their full feet once moved into a shaded side corner.

defects: The dellal's raised right arm bends vertically into his own head so the hand holding the bracelets clips against the front of his turban, while his left arm is folded stiffly across his chest.
Mother and Fatma in the background have their bodies facing sideways while Mother's head twists back awkwardly toward the camera.
tiles.fix: Extend the dellal's right arm clearly forward and above his head away from his turban in an open, dynamic auctioneer call pose, and orient Mother and Fatma cleanly toward the dellal.

defects: Same arm-to-turban clipping and stiff pose on the dellal as s12 44.1.
The vocabulary callout box 'le dellal : le courtier des enchères' is placed on the far left over an empty shop counter behind the Boy instead of near the dellal on the right.
tiles.fix: Move the 'le dellal' label to the right side of the frame pointing to the auctioneer, after fixing his raised arm pose.

defects: Prop duplication and broken handoff: Father holds a pair of bracelets in his extended right hand at chest height while the dellal's raised right hand STILL holds a duplicate pair of bracelets above his turban.
Mother and Fatma in their large white haïks have moved right behind Father and the dellal's hands, cluttering the silhouette of the bracelet exchange.
tiles.fix: Lower the dellal's right arm so he hands the single pair of bracelets directly into Father's outstretched hand, and keep Mother and Fatma two steps further back to leave a clean gap behind the hands.

defects: In this medium crop of s12 51.7, the duplicated bracelets (one pair still raised above the dellal's turban, another pair in Father's hand at chest level) and lack of hand-to-hand contact are glaringly visible against Mother's white haïk directly behind their arms.
tiles.fix: Apply the single-prop handoff pose from s12 51.7 with the dellal's lowered hand releasing the bracelets into Father's palm against a clear background.

defects: Mother's forearms and hands clip straight through the solid front mesh of her closed white haïk at chest level, and she holds the bracelets static under her chin instead of slipping them onto her wrist ('les essaya').

Mother's foreground placement overlaps and cuts off half of Father's face and body behind her right shoulder, while Fatma's haïk in the mid-ground terminates high above the floor so she appears to float.
tiles.fix: Part or drape the haïk folds so Mother's hands emerge naturally, pose her sliding one bracelet onto her wrist, shift Father half a step left so his face is unobstructed, and ground Fatma on the floor plane.

defects: Mother and Fatma form a massive white wall blocking the center of the frame, with Father half-hidden behind Mother on the left and the dellal almost completely occluded behind Fatma on the right, making the bargaining ('Un quart d'heure de discussion') unreadable.
Mother's hands still clip straight through the front mesh of her haïk while casting a stark diagonal stick-like shadow across her chest.
tiles.fix: Stage Father and the dellal facing each other in the foreground/mid-ground in an active bargaining exchange while Mother and Fatma stand slightly to the side inspecting the bracelets.

defects: Father is supposed to be the focus ('Mon père fit un signe'), but he is pushed to the left behind Boy and raises his hand directly into the back of Mother's white haïk while the dellal stands stiffly with arms down on the right.
The weeping woman in red from beat s12 27.0 is inexplicably wedged between Mother and Fatma, and an orphaned text box ('quatre / cinq' from s12 60.5) floats on the right side of the frame.
tiles.fix: Remove the extra woman in red and the leftover 'quatre / cinq' text box, pull Father forward into clear view making a distinct hand signal toward the dellal, and pose the dellal reacting to the new bid.

defects: The shot fails to deliver the beat ('Sa main seule voyagea un moment au-dessus des têtes, avec les bracelets'): instead of a close/medium framing emphasizing the dellal's raised hand and bracelets above the crowd, it is a distant wide shot where his hand clips into his own turban.

All scene extras—including the weeping man and woman in red from s12 27.0—are piled into a colliding cluster with Mother, Fatma, Father, and the dellal in the middle of the alley, while Father's raised hand remains frozen clipping into Mother's haïk.
tiles.fix: Remove the intersecting background characters, lower Father's arm, and reframe to a tighter high-angle or medium shot focused on the dellal's arm raised high above the characters' heads holding the bracelets.

worst_problem: During the bracelet auction sequence (s12 51.7–s12 77.5), broken prop and character staging ruins the storytelling: the bracelets are duplicated in s12 51.7/56.1 (held above the dellal's head and in Father's hand simultaneously), Mother's hands clip straight through the solid front mesh of her oversized haïk while occluding Father and the dellal, and extraneous characters from earlier beats collide inside the group in s12 70.4/77.5.
